title: -- // incoming transmission // -- // official release of living world fx vol. 1!
author: Derefringence
selftext:
not just a self promo post, i wanted to forward my thanks to the open mind and general views of the r/aigamedev community. 

as for the workflow, i had codex (astra) run part of the production and the boring automation tasks using aseprite with the CLI and via an MCP server. i also had it make a promo video test but it didn't turn out so good. i used it as a reference and had claude code (opus 5.5) take the assets and re make the video. 

both the audio and music are coded, and no generative AI has been used for images, references, audio or anything like that. whenever references were needed i either used real life videos or built simulations on Blender and then rendered very low res. 

feel free to shoot a DM if you want to test the sprites, mention this community and I'll send you the operator access pack free of charge (2$ value) 

check out the pack here: [https://zimraz.itch.io/living-world-fx-urban-vol-1](https://zimraz.itch.io/living-world-fx-urban-vol-1)

you can also find the HD trailer [on youtube](https://youtu.be/vCXJRmpWXAc)!
